notes: Brief's P covers patronage alongside own cult. Poletti: Augustus initiated at Eleusis 31 BC and Hellenized Apollo while reviving ancestral Roman cults. Roman state cult kept, so P not Y. Hellenization predating 67 BCE does not exclude in-window patronage.

notes: Britannica: Sumanguru took Kumbi c.1203 and adhered to Susu traditional religion; Sosso power ended in the 1230s war with Kangaba, no conversion. Neither Britannica nor the Met mentions Sosso writing; oral-tradition sourcing is not evidence of non-literacy, so U.
